grammar.closure: diff = decoded_end - footer_offset (EOF for numeric tables); validate complete terminator for person_names, then compare full reconstructed bytes to the entire decompressed member
grammar.encoding: UTF-8 strictly decoded and re-encoded for every string including both Chinese scripts; no UTF-16LE branch observed

entity_table_record.footer: no footer bytes; exact EOF after declared record count
entity_table_record.framing: no record length or per-record selector; table-specific ordered slots
entity_table_record.key: u32 DBID (strictly increasing within each member)
entity_table_record.table_type: from member filename, not a per-row field

person_names.footer: u32 zero in place of next nonempty first string length, must be at EOF
person_names.key_note: Text-keyed name lexicon; qualifier ID can be 0xffffffff and is not a universal entity UID. Not part of the core entity join.
person_names.record: SSSS + u32 qualifier_id + u16 qualifier + u8 form

grammar.string_count: Counts every nonempty, non-null physical string field occurrence, including variants and person-name lexicon fields; counts base/update separately, no deduplication.

tokens.B: u8; preserve raw per-slot scalar/grammar flag
tokens.H: u16; t3 trailing nation-table ordinal or 0xffff sentinel; compare with current t57 Cnti/Cbni in club_nation_comparison
tokens.S: u32 byte length then strict UTF-8 bytes; 0 empty; 0xffffffff NULL (no bytes)
tokens.V: u8 count, then count * {S, u16 field_type, u8 form}

variant_semantics.B: For string-associated lanes, noun/article classes; e.g. French t9 has 4 for Algérie (elision), 2 for Bénin (masculine), English t9 uses 0xff. Not all raw scalar codes or all t18/t56 scalar lanes have a proven semantic label.
variant_semantics.field_type: Selects a lexical field: t9/type 1 is demonym/adjective; Greek t9 types 24/25 are full/short nation names, t35 types 3/4 select masculine/feminine position term in French.
variant_semantics.form: Language- and field-dependent inflection index, not a universal gender/plural bitmask. French and Spanish t9/type 1: 1 masc.sg., 2 fem.sg., 3 masc.pl., 4 fem.pl.; Italian same lane: 1 masc.pl., 2 fem.sg., 3 fem.pl. Greek also encodes case.

join.key: (localization table type, u32 row key) -> (mapped server table, identity DBID) -> identity UID
join.language_labels: client_db/table_8.dat: internal file ID = identity DBID = identity UID
join.nation_identity_mirror: server/9 and server/10 have identical DBID→(UID, ordinal) maps, 251/251
join.precedence: Per language and DBID: prefer the entire update row if present, otherwise base. No cross-language fallback.
